Rentman | DevOps Engineer, Senior Frontend Developer | Utrecht, NL | HYBRID | Full-time | https://rentman.io

Rentman is B2B SaaS that event and media production teams in 70+ countries use to manage gear, crew and scheduling. 100+ people, office in Utrecht and Toronto.

DevOps Engineer: own our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, observability and cloud security. The main projects are moving from ClickOps to infrastructure as code and getting Fargate and Kubernetes onto one standard. You've led an IaC migration (Terraform/Pulumi/CDK) and you write code. https://rentman.io/jobs/devops-engineer

Senior Frontend Developer: build the onboarding flows, data import tools and setup wizards that get new customers live fast. Angular SPA with 3,500+ components and AG-Grid; we move to new Angular versions within weeks of release. Angular is a plus but not required; 3+ years as a senior in product-led SaaS is. https://rentman.io/jobs/senior-frontend-developer-customer-l...

If you apply, please mention HN
